pmoves-cipher._note: Cipher SSE requires bearer auth once CIPHER_API_TOKEN is set on the serving node. The ':-' fallback was REMOVED 2026-09-02 (B850): it was the right remedy only while NO node had a token, because an empty bearer was then accepted (200). Once the token is provisioned (`python pmoves/scripts/bootstrap_env.py --rotate CIPHER_API_TOKEN`, then chit-export + secrets-funnel + `make -C pmoves up-cipher`), an empty bearer is a MEASURED 401. WHY BARE, STATED ACCURATELY: the ':-' failure was never invisible -- pmoves/scripts/session_check.py classifies it `soft` and prints `!`. Bare ${CIPHER_API_TOKEN} is classified `hard` and prints `x`, and also lands in the _pmoves_roster_verdicts degraded list. So this is a SEVERITY UPGRADE in a manually-run tool (! -> x), not silence turned into signal; _pmoves_roster_verdicts has no production reader yet (writer is mcp_roster_normalize.py:80) and wiring one is a follow-up lane. ORDERING, MEASURED: once the var is set BOTH forms put identical bytes on the wire, so the roster form cannot protect the window between secrets-funnel and the container recreate -- in that window the real token 401s against a still-fail-open server (measured on B850). Provision each node FIRST, verify, land the roster change LAST. FLEET: deploy/provision/claude-pmoves.sh reads the roster from `git show origin/main:.claude/mcp.json`, not the working tree, so this file changes behaviour on EVERY node the moment it merges, whatever branch that node is on. A node with no CIPHER_API_TOKEN goes 200 -> 401 for claude-code and crush; .kimi/mcp.json, all 7 Hermes profiles and all 17 configs/claws entries are already bare on origin/main and already 401 there. A bare `claude` session does NOT show this as degraded -- there is no .mcp.json in this repo, so a bare session loads NO PMOVES servers at all (MEASURED: `claude mcp list` returns 14 servers, none of them PMOVES) and never runs the normalizer. Start sessions through the launcher. MEASURED 2026-09-02 against a sidecar cipher process with the token set: no header 401, 'Bearer ' (empty) 401, literal 'Bearer ${CIPHER_API_TOKEN}' 401, correct token -> /mcp/sse 200 + initialize + tools/list = 10 tools. NOTE /health is 200 in BOTH postures -- it cannot tell you the auth posture. PATH VERIFIED 2026-08-12, unchanged: /mcp/sse answers; /api/mcp/sse and /sse both 404. Runbook: pmoves/docs/operations/CIPHER_AUTH_RUNBOOK.md

pmoves-hirag-mcp._purpose: Hi-RAG v2 MCP bridge — hybrid vector (Qdrant) + graph (Neo4j) + full-text (Meilisearch) retrieval with cross-encoder reranking, over the existing PMOVES retrieval APIs. STDIO, per the submodule's own README ("Thin stdio MCP bridge") and the invocation it documents. It was first registered here as SSE against http://pmoves-hirag-mcp:8080/sse — no compose service by that name exists, the submodule ships no Dockerfile and no SSE server, so the endpoint was unreachable. If an SSE container is built later, switch this back and add the compose service in the same change. Source of truth for the active flag: pmoves/config/agent_registry.yaml `pmoves_hirag_mcp.status`.

pmoves-nats-fleet._purpose: Cross-node NATS publish/subscribe to the fleet hub on KVM4-2. Replaces SSH-from-CLI dance for signal dispatch (e.g., claw.task.assign.v1 SPARK cascades). Server code shipped in PR #1490; this is the .claude/mcp.json registration enabling the tools at runtime.

env._NATS_CREDS_NOTE: v0.2 (spec §7b): path to a CORE-account .creds (nsc-minted, CHIT-vault-held). When set, the MCP binds to the CORE account (transport-trust gate) and CHIT-signs CHIT-aware subjects (payload-provenance gate) — two-gate model, spec §11. Unset = legacy NATS_URL user/pass (single-principal bus). Fallback is enforced in code, not assumed: _nats_creds() rejects an empty value AND an unresolved "${...}" placeholder (a bare "${NATS_CREDS}" survives literally when the var is absent and would otherwise be a truthy bogus path), so the MCP uses NATS_URL until the funnel materializes the .creds. "${NATS_CREDS:-}" also collapses to empty where the launcher supports default-expansion.

cloudflare._purpose: Cloudflare MCP for Pages deploy + DNS zone management (cataclysmstudios.com). Requires CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN + CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID in env. Added Layer 2.1 of COMBINER pipeline (2026-05-26).

cloudflare-api._purpose: Cloudflare's official REMOTE API MCP (https://mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp) — the ENTIRE Cloudflare API (2,500+ endpoints incl. all of DNS) exposed via two Code-Mode tools search()/execute(), ~1k tokens instead of ~1M for native schemas. OAuth on first connect uses the operator's admin-scoped Cloudflare account. Use this (not the stdio 'cloudflare' entry, which needs a CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN that is currently empty in env.shared) to list/manage pmoves.ai DNS records and to mint/verify a Zone:DNS:Edit token for Traefik ACME (CLOUDFLARE_DNS_API_TOKEN). Ref: Cloudflare docs /agents/model-context-protocol/cloudflare/servers-for-cloudflare/ (verified 2026-08-18).

pmoves-supabase._purpose: Self-hosted PMOVES Supabase via PostgREST (NOT cloud mcp.supabase.com). comfy._purpose: Official ComfyUI MCP (comfy.org) — exposes the ComfyUI engine over MCP: build/edit/run + save/re-run workflows, search models/nodes/templates, generate image/video/audio/3D. Lets the creator-operator computer-use agent drive workflows via MCP instead of clicking the UI.
comfy._note: This is the HOSTED CLOUD endpoint (drives Comfy's cloud). OAuth sign-in on first use in Claude Code (no key needed). For the SELF-HOSTED fleet ComfyUI (project_creator_comfyui_selfhost), a local ComfyUI-API MCP (community, via ComfyUI /prompt) is a separate follow-up to drive the operator's own instance. Claude Code skips gracefully if not signed in.

supabase-db._purpose: Postgres MCP (crystaldba/postgres-mcp 'Postgres MCP Pro') for the SELF-HOSTED Supabase Postgres — the DDL/RLS/migration sibling of pmoves-supabase. Does what PostgREST CANNOT: run SQL, inspect schema + RLS policies, apply migrations, EXPLAIN/health/index analysis. DELIBERATE, SCOPED EXCEPTION to the 'never raw psql' rule (CATALOG.md): data-plane CRUD still goes through pmoves-supabase (PostgREST); this is for schema/migration/RLS work only (the same class as bootstrap's docker-exec psql).
supabase-db._setup: Set SUPABASE_DB_URI to a HOST-reachable connection string: postgresql://pmoves:<SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD>@<host>:<port>/pmoves (the Supabase CLI stack publishes Postgres on a host port — use localhost/host.docker.internal + that port, NOT the internal 'supabase-db' service name). access-mode=unrestricted enables DDL/DML for migrations/RLS; use --access-mode=restricted for read-only audits.
